title: Bulky; flimsy
text: Bulky; flimsy. I had a hard time finding where to use this towel holder because it’s so long. Didn’t really fit on the side of my refrigerator. Also, the handles are flimsy  than I thought they would be. This is a cool concept. I just wish it wasn’t so big and the metal was stronger.

product_metadata.title: LUOOV Magnetic Paper Towel Holder, Dish Towel Holder, Wall Mount Paper Towel Holder, Magnetic Towel Bar for Refrigerator & Door & Oven & Bathroom, No Drilling, Modern, White (Dual Bar)
features: PAPER TOWELS BY YOUR SIDE - This paper towel holder is designed with powerful magnetic back that attaches sturdily to any metal surface. Use on your grill, fridge, tailgate or anywhere you need paper towels on hand. Free up counter space.
POWEFUL MAGNET - The strong magnet makes this paper towel holder perfect for using on your magnetized metal grill, refrigerator tailgate on your truck, or any area that has a metal surface.
BUILT TO LAST - The paper towel holder is made from the durable carbon steel with high corrosion resistance, which can be used for a long time.
EASY LOADING - Features easy loading and unloading and simple application weather it be your kitchen your backyard your truck or your bathroom.
DIMENSIONS - The product is 9.6"L x 2.2"W x 2.6"H; weight 0.34kg
